title: Sr Product Manager II
jd_excerpt:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Axon's mission is simple and bold: Protect Life.

We build technology that helps first responders, security teams and communities act with speed, clarity and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security and international agencies detect, assess and respond to threats.

Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors and location data into a unified operating picture, and the map is where that picture comes together. It shows where every officer, vehicle, camera, drone and sensor is, what state it is in, and what is happening around it. We're building a map that stays clear under pressure, so operators and responders can see what matters and act in seconds.

Your Impact

As Senior Product Manager for Maps & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus shows the world in real time. You'll own the live map, floor plans and the presence layer: the "dots on the map" that tell operators who and what is where, and whether that information is fresh.

You'll own the map experience operators use every shift and the map services every other team builds on. Your work will let any device, sensor or data source appear on the map in a consistent way, without bespoke work for each one. That spans body cameras, fleet vehicles, drones, CCTV, sensors and third-party devices, indoors and outdoors.

You'll also lead the map in Axon's next generation of Fusus: role-based experiences built from shared components, where every role gets a map designed for its job. Your work will help responders find the nearest resource, follow an incident as it moves and reconstruct what happened afterwards, directly advancing Axon's mission to Protect Life.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Maps & Presence product roadmap, focused on a map that is clear, consistent and fast to act from
  • Define one behavior model for every real-time dot on the map (how each device type looks, clusters, shows state and freshness) and retire legacy formats
  • Own the map services and contracts (layers, geo-boundaries, floor plans, the Presence API) that let other teams put new data on the map through self-service
  • Build self-service floor plans and map layers for customer admins, so setup no longer depends on Support or Professional Services
  • Lead the map and floor-plan components for Fusus's role-based experiences, shipping them in today's Fusus first
  • Deliver location history (breadcrumbs) and cross-camera tracking for investigations, with Search and video teams
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency and reliable map experiences across web and mobile
  • Engage law enforcement and enterprise users in real-time crime centers and the field to validate needs and test improvements
  • Use metrics and feedback to set priorities: dot freshness, map load time, presence coverage, time from alert to action
  • Support go-to-market, training and rollout with cross-functional teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Operators trust what they see on the map: every device looks and behaves the same way, and stale data is obvious
  • New devices and data sources appear on the map in days, without map-team engineering work
  • Customers set up their own floor plans and layers, and filter the map to what matters to them
  • Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention and positive field feedback
  • Every second saved contributes to safer outcomes for officers, teams and the public

What You Bring

  • 6–8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on map-based, location or real-time products
  • Experience building products where speed, clarity and reliability directly affect outcomes
  • Strong grasp of geospatial and presence concepts: map rendering and clustering, layers and tiles, geofences, indoor mapping, location data quality and freshness
  • Familiarity with live video, sensor networks, fleet or asset tracking, drones and IoT integrations
  • Experience with platform products that other teams build on, including APIs and data contracts
  • Track record of turning user insight into clear product direction and focused execution
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through roadmap, design, delivery and iteration
  • Clear communicator who drives alignment, decisions and measurable outcomes

  • Competitive base salary and RSUs

  • GymPass subscription
  • Life assurance and income protection
  • Career growth, learning support, and wellness resources

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.
